text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder has invited me to watch her dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I appreciate you making the time for this.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Your opinion will be really helpful to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …Let's do that last section once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's giving the rehearsal her all, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finishing the dance, she doesn't seem satisfied with her performance.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The choreography for the chorus isn't clicking.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I understand the rhythm perfectly well, but I still can't dance it as well as the others.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Do you have any idea what I'm doing wrong?
choice_data_list: What if you were more expressive?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Interesting. Perhaps I was too focused on finesse.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Perhaps if I hit the beat with more force…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll set aside the graceful imagery and try visualizing martial arts during the main hook instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems adding a bit of power to her step did the trick.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're right—that is a crucial aspect.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In my efforts to perfect the individual steps, I may have refined away the dance's personality.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Racing demands a healthy dose of ambition, so the same should hold true for winning concerts.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll try to convey the true depths of my feelings which none of the others can surpass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe… this might make me appear a little bolder than usual, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder returns to her dance practice with more pep in her step.
